description:
The US Army Contracting Command – Detroit Arsenal (ACC-DTA) intends to solicit and award a sole sourced, five-year Firm-Fixed-Price requirements contract to Honeywell International

This action will be for the following item:

Noun: Dynamic Reference Unit Hybrid (DRUH)

NSN: 6605-01-422-0715

Part Number: 12967900

NAICS: 811210

Quantity: 180

Unit of Issue: Each

Option Quantity: NA

Inspection/Acceptance: Origin

FOB: Origin

Level of Preservation: Military

Level of Packaging: B

The solicitation, W56HZV-24-R-0099 is anticipated for release in two to four weeks from the date of this notice. The solicitation will contain the required technical information and a specified due date and time.

CAUTION: This solicitation will be issued electronically as will any amendments thereto. Because of this, the Government is under no obligation and is, in fact, unable to maintain a mailing list. The burden is therefore on any interested parties to periodically access the above internet address (sam.gov) to obtain any amendments and to respond to them prior to the solicitation closing date and time. Failure to obtain and acknowledge any amendment(s) may render your proposal nonresponsive and result in the rejection of the proposal.

NOTICE TO ALL CONTRACTORS: All contractors who provide goods/services to the Department of  War (DoW) must be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM). You may register via the internet and obtain further information at https://www.sam.gov/SAM/pages/public/loginFAQ.jsf .

If you have further question, contact the Contract Specialist, Angelo Wilson, via electronic mail at angelo.b.wilson.civ@army.mil.
